statement.zh: 三角洲法拉哈波兰队 1998–2011 年发掘见《法拉哈》I（2012）综合。
statement.en: At Tell el-Farkha in the Delta, Polish 1998–2011 excavations are synthesized in Tell el-Farkha I (2012).
